summary: Helport AI Limited filed a Form 6-K disclosing the resignation of Di Shen as Interim Chief Financial Officer and director effective October 30, 2026, attributed to personal reasons and expressly not the result of any disagreement over operations, policies, or practices. On October 31 the Nomination Committee recommended, and the Board appointed, Ran Ding, 45, as full-time CFO effective November 2, 2026; she has over 20 years of finance experience, most recently at Guoneng Shuzhi Technology. No family relationships or appointment arrangements were disclosed. Watch for follow-on 20-F disclosure and any gaps in interim financial oversight.
